title: Rovv - Book Rides in Africa
description: Book rides, get fare estimates, and manage trips across African cities with Rovv.
summary: Book rides, get fare estimates, and manage trips across African cities with Rovv.
offersHint: Book rides, get fare estimates, and manage trips across African cities with Rovv. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://rovvafrica.com/api/v1/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_places
toolsPreview.description: Search for a location by name. Returns a list of matching places with addresses. Use this to find the pickup or dropoff location before booking a ride.

toolsPreview.name: get_place_details
toolsPreview.description: Get the exact coordinates and full address for a place using its place_id (returned from search_places). Call this after search_places to get lat/lng needed for fare estimates and booking.

toolsPreview.name: get_fare_estimate
toolsPreview.description: Get available vehicle types and fare estimates for a trip. Returns a list of vehicle options with prices, ETAs, and vehicle type IDs needed for booking.

toolsPreview.name: book_ride
toolsPreview.description: Book a Rovv ride. Requires pickup/dropoff coordinates, a vehicle_type ID (from get_fare_estimate), and payment method. Returns booking confirmation with ride number.

toolsPreview.name: cancel_ride
toolsPreview.description: Cancel an active ride. Optionally provide a reason.

toolsPreview.name: get_current_ride
toolsPreview.description: Get the status of the user's current active ride, including driver details, ETA, and ride status.

toolsPreview.name: get_ride_history
toolsPreview.description: Get the user's past ride history. Returns recent completed and cancelled rides.

toolsPreview.name: get_route_info
toolsPreview.description: Get driving route information between two points including distance, duration, and polyline.

toolsPreview.name: get_wallet_balance
toolsPreview.description: Get the user's Rovv wallet balance, total added, total spent, and recent transactions.
